nodes.name: Coherent Difference
nodes.summary: Part 4 prose lesson (order 2) that plants the structural intuition that global meaning emerges from local differences glued together coherently, walking the chain distinction -> relation -> topology -> sheaves -> category theory as conceptual scaffolding for the upcoming Embeddings chapter. Static Markdown with heavy LaTeX and citations; no interactive JS.
nodes.languageNotes: Static PHP lesson; no matching .js module. Extractor-reported 'classes' (the) are false positives scraped from prose, not real symbols. Uses data-mathlevel optional blocks and smart-quote citation divs.

nodes.name: From World to Model: Coherent Representation
nodes.summary: Part 4 prose lesson (order 3) that argues descent is a single operation under three names, unifying sheaf/inf-descent, the coherence theory of truth, and post-foundationalist epistemology, bridging perception to model theory and AI world models. Static Markdown with dense math diagrams; no interactive JS.
nodes.languageNotes: Static PHP lesson; no matching .js module. Extractor-reported 'classes' (of, when, from) are false positives from prose. Extensive array/diagram LaTeX and olog diagrams.

nodes.name: Diffusion Models
nodes.summary: Part 4 lesson (order 14) on denoising diffusion (DDPM, Latent/Stable Diffusion) covering the forward noising/reverse denoising process, classifier-free guidance, the text-to-image pipeline, and DiT/flow-matching, with inline JS interactive widgets for noise sliders, tokenizer/embedding, and cross-attention.
nodes.languageNotes: All interactive JS is inlined in one <script> block within the PHP template rather than a separate .js module file. Uses a seeded Mulberry32 PRNG for deterministic noise, Gaussian (Box-Muller) sampling, and mounts widgets imperatively via innerHTML string concatenation.

nodes.name: loadDiffusionModule
nodes.summary: Public module entry point that updates the loading status and resolves immediately, satisfying the blog's load*Module() queue contract; the real work happens in the boot promise at the bottom of the script.

nodes.name: loadCleanImage
nodes.summary: Loads the clean astronaut image into a 256x256 canvas and resolves its ImageData, providing the source pixels that buildColorFrames turns into the noise-slider frames.

nodes.name: buildColorFrames
nodes.summary: Pre-computes 21 noisy RGB frames by blending the clean image with seeded Gaussian noise along x_t = sqrt(1-t) x_0 + sqrt(t) e, returning base64 PNG data URLs for the forward/reverse process sliders.

nodes.name: mountNoiseSlider
nodes.summary: Renders an image-plus-range-input widget into a container that scrubs through the pre-built noise frames, used for both the forward (clean to noise) and reverse (noise to clean) diffusion process demonstrations.

nodes.name: makeTokenizerViz
nodes.summary: Builds a CLIP-style tokenizer-and-embedding visualization that shows a prompt split into subword tokens and each token mapped to a deterministic fake 16-dim embedding rendered as a bar chart.

nodes.name: makeCrossAttentionViz
nodes.summary: Builds an interactive cross-attention widget where clicking a prompt word highlights the region of the astronaut image that word would attend to during denoising, illustrating how text tokens condition the U-Net.
